text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency (apac) crossed configured threshold (1200ms) for route /v1/generate. alert_id=INC-20260315-APAC-P99 https://alerts.internal/redwood/INC-20260315-APAC-P99

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: automatic page fired -> sam (oncall). Incident: PD-98321. Escalation policy: oncall-sre-apac.

sam (oncall): ack - I'm on it, landing in channel. grabbing metrics now.

maya (sre): seeing huge eviction churn on kv-cache in apac, also steady CPU spike on runtime sidecars. suspect hotkey + large batches.

liam (eng-runtime): looking at tracer, long tail around decode step for a subset of requests, batching window at 128ms seems to coincide.

sam (oncall): quick check commands:
```bash
# check p99 from metrics endpoint
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/redwood/apac/latency/p99 | jq '.'
# top pods
kubectl top pods -n redwood-apac | sort -k3 -n -r | head
```

maya (sre): output snippets:
```
{"route":"/v1/generate","p50":120,"p95":620,"p99":1800,"qps":2300}
POD redwood-runtime-3 cpu%: 93 memory%: 78
kvcache-pod-7 evictions/sec: 410
```

zoe (support): got 3 support tickets flagged as "responses slow / timeout" in last 10m, two enterprise customers saw API 524 errors. notifying account owners.

eva (platform): pushing emergency routing rule to drain APAC to dedicated-pool-2 as temporary fallback. will also apply a conservative per-key rate limit to blunt hotkeys.

liam (eng-runtime): recommend disabling batching for 5m for the hot routes as experiment. I can flip the flag if SRE approves.

sam (oncall): do it. roll disable batching as a config toggle, and watch p99. if it drops, we keep for 30m and then re-evaluate.

liam (eng-runtime): running:
```bash
# disable batching for route /v1/generate
HTTP POST https://config.internal/toggles/update 
body: {"route":"/v1/generate","batching":false}
```

liam (eng-runtime): done. change propagated to apac edge in ~15s.

maya (sre): seeing p99 drop in metrics stream: 1800 -> 900 -> 520 within 2 mins. evictions/sec down to 60. cpu% on runtime pods dropping to 55.

sam (oncall): nice. paging update: PD-98321 acknowledged and mitigated by config change + routing fallback. continuing to monitor.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98321 status: acknowledged by sam at 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z.

zoe (support): updating customer messages: "We're aware of degraded response latency in APAC and have applied mitigations. No data loss. ETA to full recovery: unknown, monitoring."

maya (sre): recommendation: follow-up actions - investigate root cause of kvcache thrash (hotkey detection), add burst protection + per-customer QPS guard, add telemetry to surface batching latency contribution per key.

sam (oncall): creating incident ticket in tracker: INC-20260315-apac-p99, adding followups: GH-1234 (kvcache instrument), GH-1235 (batching-telemetry), GH-1236 (runbook update).

eva (platform): temporary routing rollback scheduled in 30m if stable. I'll keep dedicated-pool-2 scaled with +2 nodes for safety.

liam (eng-runtime): quick note: we'll avoid rolling restarts right now; that could spike latencies. prefer config flips.

sam (oncall): handoff: I'll monitor for 20m then hand to maya for deeper RCA. maya, you take next shift if it persists?

maya (sre): yep, I'll take it at +20. adding check-ins every 10m.

sam (oncall): final update for now: incident mitigation effective, customer impact limited to increased latency and a few 524s, no data loss. PD incident will remain open until postmortem. :thumbsup:

zoe (support): noted. reaching out to affected accounts with post-incident note template. :email:

incident-bot: Note: postmortem required. Please link timeline and action items to INC-20260315-apac-p99 when complete.

sam (oncall): creating initial timeline in the ticket. last observed p99 at peak 1900ms at 1709994332. moving to monitoring-only.

maya (sre): :eyes: will dig into cache eviction heuristics and hotkey detection heuristics next.

liam (eng-runtime): GH-1234/1235 assigned to eng-runtime + eng-sre. I'll start a short PR for batching telemetry.

sam (oncall): handing channel to maya for next steps. clear for now.

maya (sre): ack. leaving a short status update at 1709994640: system stable, p99 ~510ms, reverting nothing yet. continuing RCA.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98321 remains in acknowledged state. Escalation suppressed while incident in active mitigation.

sam (oncall): :white_check_mark: closing active mitigation phase. Post-incident owners: maya (SRE), liam (runtime), eva (platform), zoe (customer comms).

(End of thread)
